discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_2/cis_2.3.7.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS` and Audit control `section_2/cis_2.3.7.x/cis_2.3.7.3.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

The role applies this only when its BitLocker option is turned on.

odvs.description: This security setting determines the number of failed logon attempts that causes the machine to be locked out. NOTE: The recommended state for this setting is: 10 or fewer invalid logon attempts, but not 0. Values from 1 to 3 will be interpreted as 4.
odvs.name: max_device_password_failed_attempts

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.3.7.3 | PATCH | Ensure Interactive logon: Machine account lockout threshold is set to 10 or fewer invalid logon attempts, but not 0"
  when:
    - win11cis_rule_2_3_7_3
    - win11cis_bitlocker
  tags:
    - level1-bitlocker
    - level2-bitlocker
    - bitlocker-optional-add-on
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_2.3.7.3
  block:
    - name: "2.3.7.3 | PATCH | Ensure Interactive logon: Machine account lockout threshold is set to 10 or fewer invalid logon attempts, but not 0 | Set Variable For MaxDevicePasswordFailedAttempts"
      when: win11cis_max_device_password_failed_attempts <= 10 or win11cis_max_device_password_failed_attempts > 0
      ansible.windows.win_regedit:
        path: HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System
        name: MaxDevicePasswordFailedAttempts
        data: "{{ win11cis_max_device_password_failed_attempts }}"
        type: dword

    - name: "2.3.7.3 | AUDIT | Ensure Interactive logon: Machine account lockout threshold is set to 10 or fewer invalid logon attempts, but not 0 | Warning Check For Variable Standards"
      when: win11cis_max_device_password_failed_attempts > 10 or win11cis_max_device_password_failed_attempts == 0
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid number attempts set for win11cis_max_device_password_failed_attempts. Please read"
          - "the notes for the variable and make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."

    - name: "2.3.7.3 | AUDIT | Ensure Interactive logon: Machine account lockout threshold is set to 10 or fewer invalid logon attempts, but not 0 | Warn Count"
      when: win11cis_max_device_password_failed_attempts > 10 or win11cis_max_device_password_failed_attempts == 0
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '2.3.7.3'
